close_reason: Implemented in Jidoka commit 8ae0cbf8. Multi-call groups now always use complete preflight regardless of checkpoint policy. Tests prove review and policy stops start zero calls, serial groups run one call at a time, parallel groups remain supported, and observations keep model call order. Validation: 699 deterministic, 32 parity, and mix quality passed.
description: Repository: Jidoka. Validate the complete group and complete review or policy checks before any call starts, then schedule safe calls serially or in parallel. Acceptance: checkpoint policy does not change safety; zero calls start before approval; observations return in original call order.
title: Preflight complete tool groups before scheduling
